selection_method.rule: Retain all eligible non-ADK cases and 35 source-screened ADK cases, ensuring preregistered Tier C deployment cases remain represented; no HorusTrace output used.

stratum_exceptions.reason: Only three defensible FastAgent applications survived source-only screening of the frozen candidate universe. Inclusion criteria were not weakened; the shortfall is retained as a measured ecosystem/discovery limitation.

tier_b_selection_basis: Source-only authority-surface eligibility, balanced across six strata; no framework contributes more than 20%.
tier_c_selection_basis: Dedicated source review of repository deployment, container, cloud-runtime, IAM, service-account, identity, or provider deployment evidence. Cases with incomplete identity evidence are intentionally retained to measure correct unresolved/unsupported outcomes.
